query:
WITH RECURSIVE tree AS (
            SELECT id, 1 AS depth
            FROM documents
            WHERE id = $1

            UNION ALL

            SELECT d.id, t.depth + 1
            FROM documents d
            JOIN tree t ON d.parent_id = t.id
            WHERE d.deleted_at IS NULL
              AND t.depth < 10
        )
        UPDATE documents
        SET deleted_at = now(), deleted_batch_id = $2
        WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM tree)
